query:
SELECT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM stremio_continue_items i
            WHERE i.stremio_id = $2
              AND i.account_id = (
                  SELECT id FROM stremio_accounts
                  WHERE user_id = $1 OR user_id IS NULL
                  ORDER BY user_id NULLS LAST
                  LIMIT 1
              )
        ) AS "exists!"
